attempted_claim: For symmetric 2-(71,21,6) designs (v=71, k=21, lambda=6, order n=15): determine the full polarity census among designs admitting the nonabelian Frobenius automorphism group of order 21 that acts on the known Janko-van Trung design. A complete answer either constructs each isomorphism type of such a design with a polarity, giving an explicit 71x71 incidence matrix, the order-21 group action, the polarity permutation, and the verified list of absolute points (points incident with their polar image), or proves by exhaustive Kramer-Mesner orbit-matrix search under that group that no polarity exists or enumerates exactly which orbit matrices lift, with a tactical decomposition log certifying completeness of the polarity classification.
decisive_failure: No complete polarity census is claimed: no explicit 71x71 incidence matrix, polarity permutation, or absolute-point list was produced, and no exhaustive tactical-decomposition log covering all admissible F21 actions was completed. The proved 5-orbit nonexistence and the complete 7-orbit single-21-branch exclusion plus 777-branch counts are preserved only as working notes and count-level logs, not as audited findings, and the literature originality check could not run because the search tool returned a missing-key error.
